name: Psychneuein

bonuses.name: Mindless
bonuses.text: This threat automatically passes Resolve Tests.

abilities.name: Psychic Drone
abilities.text: Anyone hearing the droning of a swarm of Psychneuein must make a DN5 Fear test.

abilities.name: Wings
abilities.text: This threat can fly at Speed 10. A DN 5 agility roll must be made to remain in the air when injured.

abilities.name: Implantation
abilities.text: (juvenile queens only): Range 18. Spend 1 Ruin to attempt to psychically lay eggs in the mind of an agent with the PSYKER trait. Roll PSYCHIC MASTERY vs the target's WILLPOWER. If the Psychneuein is successful, a clutch of D6 eggs are implanted in the target's head, and unless removed (requiring a Medicae roll, DN 8) will messily hatch 2D6 hours later, with fatal results for the host.

Bite, and Sting (drones only). Anyone with the PSYKER trait stung by a Psychneuein Drone immediately rolls a DN6 Toughness Test. On a failure they immediately roll on the Perils of the Warp table (Wrath & Glory, pg. 262).

note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (6 Wounds, 6 Shock, no Champion bonus, a swarm creature). No Default pool printed. Skill printed 'Weapons Skill'. Melee weapons print 'Range 1'.
